architecture_contract.continental: Use the ratified authored continental T0 reference boundary field on its exact native support.
architecture_contract.oceanic: Derive age-dependent heat flow from governed ocean age using a versioned finite-plate-family cooling model, only where that model's applicability policy is valid.
architecture_contract.young_rift_ocean: Require an explicitly governed young/rift treatment; until selected, heat flow is UNKNOWN/unresolved and execution fails closed.
architecture_contract.domain_authority: physical_crust_domain_id is the categorical authority for continental/ocean branch selection; domain IDs are never interpolated numerically.
architecture_contract.join: Join the branch-specific fields under categorical support, source lineage, applicability, and uncertainty; never blend continental reference authority with ocean-model authority across a mixed boundary.
architecture_contract.global_product: A deterministically replayable global T0 derived field, not a new independent canonical authored heat-flow field.
architecture_contract.runtime_product: The serialized 64,442-node FEG heat-flow array is NUMERICAL_RUNTIME_INPUT_ONLY derived support for OrbData.

continental_branch.authority_class: GOVERNED_AUTHORED_T0_PARENT_FIELD; AUTHORIAL_T0_PRIMITIVE within the ratified B-v2 candidate lineage
continental_branch.support: Existing 180x360 cell-centered land/thermal-class support only; 14,258 cells populated; field hash 234d2c34f4bc98f72cbaa0e1b322ba781bc95fab9e7b69795fb2b3e7a03b7e2f.
continental_branch.derivation_warning: Synthetic authored class values; not derived merely from crustal thickness, not an observed Earth heat-flow grid, and not a unique continental geotherm.
continental_branch.projection: Deterministic support-aware projection may supply numerical support only; preserve class/source-cell lineage and do not claim increased physical resolution.
continental_branch.later_change: Refinement/replacement requires an explicit higher-authority physical stage; no silent overwrite.

oceanic_branch.authority_class: GOVERNED_T0_PHYSICAL_PARENT_FIELD within the ratified B-v2 candidate lineage
oceanic_branch.flux_semantics: The chosen model must declare whether output is conductive surface heat flux or total heat loss; no hydrothermal total-flux claim is implied by a conductive cooling law.
oceanic_branch.applicability: Only valid age/domain support; emit UNKNOWN when inputs are missing or model validity fails.
oceanic_branch.earth_authority: No present-day Earth heat-flow field becomes ARCANA state; any Earth-derived model requires an explicit transfer rationale and model provenance.

young_ocean_branch.age_zero: Age zero remains a valid authored age state but the conductive age law alone does not supply finite physical heat flow there.
young_ocean_branch.policy: Select a governed ridge/accretion/young-ocean treatment with explicit validity limits, or preserve heat flow as UNKNOWN outside the chosen model's validity domain.
young_ocean_branch.qLim1: Do not substitute ShellSet qLim1 for ARCANA physical age-zero heat flow.
young_ocean_branch.hydrothermal: No universal scalar correction is authorized; distinguish conductive flux from total advective-plus-conductive heat loss.

domain_join.feG_source_support_rule: Project only when incident source-cell support resolves the branch and relevant source class. Preserve source cell IDs, class/domain IDs, selection method/weights and coverage.
domain_join.mixed_physical_domain_support: UNKNOWN unless a separately governed boundary rule resolves it; do not blend ocean and continental values.
domain_join.mixed_continental_thermal_class_support: UNKNOWN unless a deterministic categorical rule is explicitly governed; do not average different class references.

unknown_policy.rule: Unknown, unsupported, or out-of-applicability values remain UNKNOWN and block OrbData input completion unless an explicitly authorized producer supplies a value.
unknown_policy.zero_sentinel: Exact zero heat flow triggers ShellSet needQ/qArray behavior. Do not serialize UNKNOWN as zero or allow an accidental zero to invoke the legacy fallback.
unknown_policy.valid_physical_zero: Must be distinguished from missing by an authorized model/interface contract; otherwise fail closed.

continental_reference_surface_heat_flow_.scope: Ratified B-v2 candidate lineage; continental thermal-class cell support only; canonical candidate is not globally promoted.

oceanic_lithosphere_age_ma.scope: Ocean age support in ratified B-v2 candidate lineage.

runtime_payload_contract.source: Global joined replayable T0 field projected to the approved FEG support.
runtime_payload_contract.readiness: NOT_READY; field generation, FEG projection, zero-sentinel path and FAIR input qualification remain incomplete.

identity_inputs: source field-package and canonical parent identities
derived producer implementation/version and environment identity
replay_identity_contract.invalidation_rule: Changing any identity input creates a different derived-state replay identity and requires recomputation/revalidation of affected support.

uncertainty_contract.continental_authored_reference: Separate class-conditioned uncertainty/provenance metadata; no numeric interval is invented. Current authorial value selection is deterministic and has no generated ensemble.
uncertainty_contract.ocean_model_structural: Separate model-family/structural alternatives; retain model identity and validity, do not collapse into parameter spread.
uncertainty_contract.ocean_parameter: Parameter covariance/ranges attached to the selected model; ensemble dimensions governed in A0.6.
uncertainty_contract.young_ocean_applicability: Separate validity/applicability uncertainty and ridge/hydrothermal structural alternatives; unsupported nodes remain UNKNOWN.
uncertainty_contract.projection_support: Separate categorical agreement, source-cell lineage, coverage and numerical projection error diagnostics.
uncertainty_contract.combination_rule: Preserve these as distinct dimensions; no single scalar uncertainty is authorized as a substitute.

rationale: A separately authored global field would duplicate the already governed continental reference and independently derived ocean branch unless it replaced both with explicit higher-authority authorship.
It would require additional independent global materialization with no present ocean values or global support authority.
It weakens causal/replay provenance by obscuring the governed ocean age/model and continental parent-field dependencies.
No contract currently calls for an independently authored global flux field.
A_EXPLICIT_GLOBAL_HEAT_FLOW_FIELD.reconsideration: Only if a later explicit authorial stage elects a complete global field as the primary physical parent and retires/roles the branch sources without duplication.

rationale: The current crustal and lithosphere thickness fields alone do not uniquely determine continental surface heat flow.
A derived continental model would require new governed assumptions about radiogenic heat production, vertical source distribution, material conductivity and basal thermal conditions.
ARCANA already has a ratified authored continental T0 reference field on its declared support; discarding it as the sole branch authority would require explicit higher-authority governance.
A derived continental geotherm/heat-flow refinement may still exist downstream as a separate, validated product; this architecture does not disallow it.

heat_flow_producer_and_ocean_specialist: Exact finite-plate-family cooling model identity/version and ARCANA transfer rationale.
Ocean model's thermal/basal/plate parameters and flux definition (conductive flux versus total heat loss).
Young/rift-ocean treatment, validity range, hydrothermal/accretion scope and age-zero finite representation.
Ocean-model parameter uncertainty/covariance and required model-form ensemble alternatives.
shellset_orbdata_heat_flow_routing_confi: qLim1 ceiling governance/value or replacement semantics; decouple it from physical age-zero behavior.
Whether downstream geotherm consistency corrections are accepted and what sensitivity/diagnostics qualify them.
Exact-zero qArray sentinel avoidance or an explicitly authorized zero/missing representation and qualified interface path.
downstream_orbdata_material_geotherm_con: Thermal conductivity by material/domain and its relationship to, but separate identity from, any ocean cooling-model conductivity.
alphaT by material/domain and active use in OrbData geotherm/density correction; do not assume it is interchangeable with a cooling-model expansivity parameter.
TAsthK derivation/configuration and consistency with TADIAB/GRADIE where active.
temLim values and active layer semantics.
TADIAB, GRADIE and ZBASTH only where confirmed active by the pinned source/configuration.
Material-property and downstream configuration uncertainty ranges/correlations/ensemble axes.
interface_and_projection: FEG categorical incident-support acceptance and boundary/thermal-class UNKNOWN resolution.
Projection method/version, lineage, coverage and numerical error acceptance evidence.
Complete global nodal field producer/package identity and deterministic replay qualification.

remaining_scientific_blockers: Exact ocean plate model/version and physical parameters remain unselected.
Young/rift/age-zero ocean heat-flow treatment remains unresolved.
qLim0/dQL_dE/qLim1 roles and values, plus ShellSet correction disposition, remain unresolved.
Downstream OrbData material/geotherm configuration and uncertainty remain unresolved.
Mixed categorical boundary and valid-zero semantics require a governed rule.
remaining_implementation_blockers: Generate the ocean heat-flow branch only after its specialist model and applicability configuration are selected and version-pinned.
Join branch fields at cell support while preserving UNKNOWN, branch lineage and uncertainty.

Project to all 64,442 FEG nodes only with qualified categorical support, source lineage and projection diagnostics; canonical partition/mesh payload prerequisites remain as documented by the T0 materialization ledger.
Serialize a complete supported field without accidental exact-zero qArray routing; qualify the explicit input path on FAIR.
Hash and replay-validate parent inputs, model/configuration, projection and derived outputs before OrbData authorization.
